review_scope: Purposeful full-local-record reading of selected new B ranks 5-50, not an exhaustive semantic review of every top50 chunk. Keyword/title screening only helps locate witnesses; it never establishes semantic absence.

30292811.quote: the combination of swaddling with prone position increases the risk of sudden infant death syndrome
30292811.reason: 讨论襁褓、睡姿与SIDS风险，不给六个月以下死亡年龄构成比例。

9056874.quote: incidence of lymphomas in cardiac versus renal patients
9056874.reason: 是心脏/肾移植免疫抑制后癌症风险，不是2001年肝移植项目停用美沙酮政策。

7482674.quote: increased susceptibility to ER stress and increased numbers of apoptotic oligodendrocytes
7482674.reason: PLP1/PMD少突胶质细胞的ER应激，没有4-PBA处理及其效应方向。

11414664.quote: the pathway acts during adulthood, to relatively advanced ages, to influence aging
11414664.reason: 线虫胰岛素信号的寿命/生殖作用时段，不提供7天/1天学习能力之比。

17050065.quote: Following prolonged exposure to an odorant, C. elegans exhibits a diminished response to the odorant for several hours.
17050065.reason: 气味适应和感觉过程有据，不给7天/1天学习能力的5%或75%结果。

45341480.quote: children from zero to four years with primary scald burns up to 10% admitted
45341480.reason: 是已经收治的特定儿童烫伤队列，比较植皮和住院时长；不提供全部门急诊烧伤患者住院率。

3690068.quote: health states include successful healing, infection, and noninfected delayed healing
3690068.reason: 烧伤敷料成本效用模型，目标为愈合/感染/延迟愈合，不是70%的门急诊住院分母。

4468861.quote: with an anti-CTLA4 antibody (anti-CTLA4) and radiation
4468861.reason: 联合放疗/检查点阻断的免疫机制与部分进展，不给原PD-1应答亚组90%无期限未来进展概率。

18557974.quote: The serum concentration of vitamin B12 remained unchanged during the intervention.
18557974.reason: 高叶酸饮食使同型半胱氨酸下降时B12不变，未识别B12单独缺乏的方向效应。

18256197.quote: renal insufficiency, B12 deficiency, and other risk factors
18256197.reason: B12缺乏是卒中风险模型调整变量；文字未给B12缺乏对同型半胱氨酸的独立方向。

37444589.quote: using in situ labelling of lymph nodes from HIV-infected children and SIV-infected macaques
37444589.reason: 是淋巴结感染/旁观者细胞凋亡，不是离体HPC感染低比例的目标细胞和分母。

2138843.quote: Development of diabetic retinopathy in patients with type 2 diabetes
2138843.reason: 讨论糖尿病微血管/大血管并发症与高血糖，并非HNF4A突变者14岁发病风险。

25510546.quote: Time-dependent increases in mRNA levels for activating transcription factor 4 (Atf4)
25510546.reason: MIN6细胞中棕榈酸相关ER应激和ATF4转录变化有直接窄范围支持；是否足以建立general marker保留范围解释不确定性，不计完整补证。

36233757.reason: Klebsiella的尿素酶活化及辅助蛋白，不能充当H. pylori活性尿素酶的五种不同亚基组成。

37768883.quote: Klebsiella aerogenes urease, a nickel-containing enzyme
37768883.reason: 同样是不同物种和活化前复合体；辅助蛋白不能直接当成目标活性酶完整结构亚基。

4320424.quote: inhibit oncogenic RAS signalling and suppress in vitro and in vivo proliferation of human pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma cells that are dependent on oncogenic KRAS
4320424.reason: KRAS–PDEδ相互作用的药理阻断降低增殖，仍非明确acute ablation；severe和操作等价性未界定。

4396105.quote: These compounds rely on the mutant cysteine for binding and therefore do not affect the wild-type protein.
4396105.reason: G12C特异抑制剂的生化作用，没有给出原急性消除KRAS的完整操作/严重生长效应。

4427392.quote: human embryonic-stem-cell-derived embryoid bodies generate a KDRlow/C-KIT(CD117)neg population
4427392.reason: 虽然出现BMP4和activin A，但来源为人胚胎干细胞，完整配方也非原成纤维细胞BMP4/activin A/CHIR99021/SU504条件。

19855358.quote: pluripotency inhibition followed by BMP4 treatment
19855358.reason: 成纤维细胞转为心肌样细胞的另一流程，不建立目标完整药物组合及CPC生成、扩增和维持。

14550841.quote: Hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) in adult marrow are believed to be derived from fetal liver precursors.
14550841.reason: 一般骨髓HSC胎肝来源不能直接移植到成年组织驻留巨噬细胞的来源命题。

4254064.reason: 研究B1a细胞前体和胚内造血部位，不是组织驻留巨噬细胞胎肝来源的直接补证。

5511240.quote: Kupffer cells, the phagocytes of fetal origin that line the liver sinusoids
5511240.reason: 只明确fetal origin和肝内驻留位置，没有把来源器官确定为fetal liver；不能将驻留地点偷换成源头。

28931537.quote: In 2004, the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) Cancer Prevention Committee surveyed the members to describe involvement in clinical prevention activities.
28931537.reason: 是ASCO预防实践调查，不给非洲训练医师来源国在美存量组成排名。

14361849.quote: continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) compared with bi-level positive airway pressure (BiPAP)
14361849.reason: CPAP/BiPAP无创通气比较，不是allogeneic/autologous机械循环支持的急性MI治疗比较。

20754359.quote: Comparison between different therapeutic approaches is complicated by the range of natural history of ATLL
20754359.reason: 感染细胞增殖和ATLL治疗综述，不给英国HTLV1感染总人数。

35087728.quote: each measure has limited predictive validity
35087728.reason: 依从性评估对HAART重要且有测量限制，但没有建立其相对常规结局测量更优的比较结论。

30492966.reason: ALS患者血液支原体培养/PCR，不是细菌脑膜炎CSF培养的目标标本/病种。

12225214.quote: MIR1 and MIR2 are two E3 ubiquitin ligases encoded by Kaposi's sarcoma-associated herpesvirus
12225214.reason: 疱疹病毒泛素化与MHC I机制，不是MS2/Qβ的Leviviridae分类。

40949706.quote: preoperative psychosocial factors associated with weight loss following bariatric surgery
40949706.reason: 减重手术后体重变化的术前预测因素，不是术后结直肠癌或绝经后乳腺癌发病率。
